- Ask: add capacity to cover new teams (estimated incremental steady state ~220k tokens/mo; peaks ~600k tokens/day).

- Option B (12-mo term + Dedicated burst lanes): 300k committed tokens/mo + ability to burst to Dedicated pools for spikes; 20% discount on incremental usage.
